children: (NYSE: GIC), a value-added national distributor and source for industrial equipment and supplies, today announced that Anesa Chaibi, Chief Executive Officer, and Tex Clark, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will be attending the Sidoti Small Cap Conference on September 23, 2026, and the D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference on September 24, 2026.

Management will host one-on-one meetings with investors at both conferences. In addition, the Company will present at 10:45 a.m. ET on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at the Sidoti Conference.
